verdict.rationale: The evidence implies forms and guidance are publicly reachable but never directly confirms a no-account PDF download. The IRS publishes paper filing paths that presuppose obtainable forms: Form SS-4 by mail or fax to Cincinnati, and Form 15620 or a written statement for the 83(b) election. The Pub 525 update page under irs.gov/forms-pubs is ordinary public content, and the mobile-friendly forms page restricts the Online Account (ID.me) requirement to forms needing signatures, so other forms appear not to need it. The 403 on the online Form 15620 flow concerns the signed online fill path, not static downloads. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that form PDFs and their instructions download from irs.gov without sign-in, and a hands-on probe of a form PDF or instructions URL returning 200.
